topic.title: Abort, Restart, or Continue In-Progress Git Operations

body.p: To abort, restart, or continue an in-progress Git operation, use the conflict panel on Git Staging.

fig.title: Git Staging view during a cherry-pick conflict

section.title: Abort In-Progress Operation
section.p: To abort an in-progress operation, go to the conflict panel and select Abort.

section.title: Continue Rebase
section.p: To continue to the next commit during a rebase operation, select Continue Rebase.

section.title: Restart Merge
section.p: To restart a merge operation, select Restart.

note.p: You can abort or restart an in-progress operation at any time before you commit.
